recommendation: Keep this fix as-is. It is a narrow completion of the historical application in an active published page and avoids the ambiguous List/list wording called out by the issue.
issue_request: FHIR-11035 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core HTTP clarification from the DSTU2 ballot. It objected that describing a search response Bundle as a "list" suggested identifiers and also collided with the List resource name, and the approved resolution was to change the wording to "collection".
initial_application: SVN revision 11029, imported as ff03a14ae8e8334436a8c416f7f2da8a87fb0f29, partially applied the issue by changing source/http.html from list/result list wording to collection/result collection. The active source/overview-dev.html sentence retained the same disputed list wording that originated before the Jira decision in c3c5f59e2d47f318df0abd2236c3ad28b2e95dd3.
additional_context: Current source/http.html already uses collection for the RESTful search response text, and publish.ini lists overview-dev.html as a published page, so the remaining stale overview wording is in the current build scope. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no community evidence that reverses or narrows the Jira decision.
reconciliation: Changed source/overview-dev.html so the Search Response paragraph now says the response Bundle is a collection of matching resources with metadata. The change aligns the introductory page with the Jira resolution and the already-correct HTTP page without changing search semantics or examples.
source_changes: source/overview-dev.html: changed the Search Response sentence from "a list of matching resources" to "a collection of matching resources".
